result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d increase humanity’s capacity for empathy—especially toward people who seem different, distant, or easy to ignore.

Not because empathy alone solves every problem, but because so many problems become harder to ignore when people truly understand the suffering or hopes behind them. More empathy would likely make war, cruelty, neglect, and exploitation less acceptable, while making cooperation and care more natural.
